For OND 2023, CCA has lower RMSE than climatology in **32 of 38 provinces**, and PCR in **31 of 38**. For JJA 2023, the corresponding counts are **8** and **8**, despite the national comparison favouring climatology. In the four-year pooled JJA context, they become **32** and **28**. Those changes show why one year should not be turned into a province-specific forecast recommendation. The smallest support is **Daerah Khusus Ibukota Jakarta**, with **3 coarse cells**; its largest single cell carries **63.2%** of its weight. These are support diagnostics, not independent sample counts.
